sn39.16:1.1: Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajjā kho āvuso imasmim dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajitena panāvuso kim dukkaranti || || Pabbajitena kho āvuso abhirati dukkarāti || || Abhiratena panāvuso kiṃ dukkaranti || || Abhiratena kho āvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipatti dukkarāti || || Kiṃ va ciram panāvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhu arahaṃ assāti || || Na ciram āvuso ti || || Sāmaṇḍaka-saṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ
